description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application, specifically testing security features such as token authentication and OpenAPI schema endpoint. It uses pytest fixtures and FastAPI's TestClient to simulate requests and verify responses.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports the FastAPI app module based on parameter and returns a TestClient instance for testing.

methods.name: test_no_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that accessing /items without an Authorization header returns 401 Unauthorized.

methods.name: test_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that providing a valid Bearer token returns a successful response with token info.

methods.name: test_incorrect_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that providing an incorrect Authorization header results in 401 Unauthorized.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that the OpenAPI schema endpoint returns the expected API description.
